axis: esm2_t33_650M_depth1_go_terms: depth-1-only GO-term prediction, WITH ground-truth aspect input to the classifier (the aspect-conditioning half of the ablation, see trial-077)
note: Companion to trial-077, identical in every hyperparameter (unfreeze_last_n=27, batch_size=16, lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.2, output_dropout=0.2, bf16, --no-gradient-checkpointing, checkpoint-mode every-epoch, 8 epochs, 6000 train (resampled)/1000 val, seed=42, --dataset-repo-id kelmoir/cafa6-depth1) except this one adds --use-aspect-input: the classifier head (AspectConditionedEsmForSequenceClassification / AspectAwareClassificationHead in training_run.py) concatenates the dataset's ground-truth aspect_labels 3-way [C,F,P] multi-hot to the pooled CLS-token representation before the dense layer, per the user-confirmed design (concatenate to pooled output - isolates the aspect signal cleanly since the ESM backbone's own forward pass is byte-identical to trial-077, only the classifier head differs). This is deliberately an oracle/upper-bound experiment (ground-truth aspects, not predicted ones) - meant to measure how much knowing the aspect(s) alone would help depth-1 prediction, informing whether a future cascaded architecture (predict aspect first, feed it in to refine finer-term prediction) is worth pursuing, before dealing with the 'messier' case of using predicted (not ground-truth) aspects. Fresh start from facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D, same as trial-077 (not resumed from trial-075/076 - incompatible label space/head shape, see trial-077's note). --push-to-hub deliberately NOT set for the same reason as trial-077 - pushes only to kelmoir/cafa6-esm@trial-078. --run-diagnostic is auto-appended by build_notebook.py.
